A Poffin Mixer can be used by any Trainer to create @CompSearch[Items Poffin]{Poffins}. You simply insert cooking ingredients worth @Poke[500], and at least one of the listed berries. You create two Poffins that raises the Contest Stat most represented by the berries used by +1 Contest Die. Some Berries can raise multiple Contest Stats; you choose which to raise when using these Berries to make Poffins. Poffins can be purchased for @Poke[500] in bakeries.
